info.title: NasrPlus - Computer Trade Guild Member Management API
info.description: Complete OpenAPI 3.0 specification for NasrPlus API (Iranian Computer Trade Guild Organization). Includes endpoints for members, company profiles, addresses, contact telephones, and all guild classification lookups.

tags.name: Members
tags.description: Core guild member registration, lifecycle, query, and profile management

tags.name: Member Addresses
tags.description: Postal address management for individual and corporate members

tags.name: Member Telephones
tags.description: Contact phone numbers, mobile, and telecommunication lines

tags.name: Companies
tags.description: Corporate entity profiles and organizational affiliations

tags.name: Lookups - Membership Types
tags.description: Classifications: Individual, Legal Entity, Store, Honorary

tags.name: Lookups - Specializations
tags.description: Guild technical branches (Software, Hardware, Network, etc.)

tags.name: Lookups - Ranks
tags.description: Guild professional grades and qualification levels (Grade 1 to 3)

tags.name: System
